about_the_game:
Honour your Chapter's proud martial heritage with the Imperial Fists Cosmetic Pack!

This Pack contains more than 40 cosmetic items and options including chapter heraldry for the left and right pauldrons, decals, unique helmets, knee markings, and colour packs from 8 Imperial Fists Successor Chapters:

Crimson Fists

- Leviadon Blue Colour Pack

- Right Pauldron Fire Support marking

- Right Pauldron Battleline marking

- Right Pauldron Close Support marking

- Right Pauldron Veteran marking

- Right Pauldron Command marking

Celestial Lions

- Left Pauldron Chapter Heraldry

- Teclis Blue Colour Pack

- Right Pauldron Fire Support marking x2

- Left Greave Imperial Fists marking

Subjugators

- Left Pauldron Chapter Heraldry

- Orruk Flesh Colour Pack

- Right Pauldron Fire Support marking

- Right Greave Imperial Fist marking

- Left Pauldron Armour Piece

Sons Of The Phoenix

- Left Pauldron Chapter Heraldry

- Naggaroth Night Colour Pack

- Screaming Bell Colour Pack

- Right Pauldron Close Support marking

- Right Greave Imperial Fists marking

Red Templars

- Left Pauldron Chapter Heraldry

- Astorath Red Colour Pack

- Right Pauldron Close Support marking

- Left Greave Imperial Fist Marking

- Right Pauldron Armour Piece

Invaders

- Left Pauldron Chapter Heraldry

- Warboss Green Colour Pack

- Right Pauldron Battleline marking

- Right Greave Imperial Fists marking

- Armour Piece Helmet

Hammers Of Dorn

- Left Pauldron Chapter Heraldry

- Troll Slayer Orange Colour Pack

- Right Greave Imperial Fist Marking

- Left Greave Imperial Fist Marking

- Armour Piece Cuirasse

The Imperial Fists Cosmetic Pack is available as part of the Season Pass 2.

content_descriptors.notes:
Gameplay consists of frequent combat scenarios with characters using their weapons to slash/stab enemies.

Strong Language is used in the dialogue.
